name: acceptedNameUsage
definition: The full name, with authorship and date information if known, of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) dwc:Taxon.

name: acceptedNameUsageID
definition: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) taxon.

name: acceptedScientificName
definition: The currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) name for the scientificName.

name: acceptedScientificNameID
definition: A unique identifier for the acceptedScientificName.

name: AcceptedTaxon
definition: The currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) name for the ScientificName.

name: AcceptedTaxonID
definition: A global unique identifier for the parent to the AcceptedTaxon.

name: acceptedTaxonID
definition: An identifier for the name of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) taxon. See acceptedTaxon.

name: acceptedTaxonName
definition: The currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) name for the scientificName.

name: acceptedTaxonNameID
definition: A unique identifier for the acceptedTaxonName.

name: AccessConstraints
definition: A description of constraints on the use of the data as shared or access to further data that is not shared.

name: accordingTo
definition: Abstract term to attribute information to a source.

name: accuracy
definition: Abstract term to capture error information about a measurement or fact.

name: associatedMedia
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of associated ac:Media resources.

name: associatedOccurrences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers of other dwc:Occurrence records and their associations to this dwc:Occurrence.

name: associatedOrganisms
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers of other dwc:Organisms and the associations of this dwc:Organism to each of them.

name: associatedReferences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of associated dcterms:BibliographicResources.

name: associatedSequences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources for dwc:NucleotideSequences associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: associatedTaxa
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers or names of dwc:Taxon records and the associations of this dwc:Occurrence to each of them.

name: basionym
definition: The basionym (botany) or basonym (bacteriology) of the scientificName.

name: basionymID
definition: A unique identifier for the basionym (botany) or basonym (bacteriology) of the scientificName.

name: basisOfRecord
definition: The specific nature of the data record.

name: bed
definition: The full name of the lithostratigraphic bed from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: behavior
definition: A behavior shown by a dwc:Organism.

name: binomial
definition: The combination of genus and first (species) epithet of the scientificName.

name: caste
definition: A social caste of a dwc:Organism.

name: catalogNumber
definition: An identifier (preferably unique) for a resource within a collection.

name: CatalogNumberNumeric
definition: The numeric value of the catalogNumber, used to facilitate numerical sorting and searching by ranges.

name: class
definition: The full scientific name of the class in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: collectionCode
definition: A name, acronym, coden, or initialism identifying a collection.

name: collectionID
definition: An identifier for a collection.

name: continent
definition: The name of the continent in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: coordinatePrecision
definition: A decimal representation of the precision of the coordinates given in the dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude.

name: coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
definition: A horizontal distance (in meters) from a given dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude describing the smallest circle containing the whole of the dcterms:Location. Zero is not a valid value for this term.

name: country
definition: The name of the country or major administrative unit in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: countryCode
definition: The standard code for the country in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: county
definition: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than stateProvince (county, shire, department, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: cultivarEpithet
definition: Part of the name of a cultivar, cultivar group or grex that follows the dwc:scientificName.

name: dataGeneralizations
definition: Actions taken to make the shared data less specific or complete than in its original form. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.

name: Dataset
definition: The category of information pertaining to a logical set of records.

name: datasetID
definition: An identifier for the set of data. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to a collection or institution.

name: datasetName
definition: A name of a source dataset.

name: dateIdentified
definition: The date on which the dwc:Identification was made.

name: day
definition: The integer day of the month on which the dwc:Event occurred.

name: decimalLatitude
definition: A geographic latitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of a dcterms:Location.

name: decimalLongitude
definition: A geographic longitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of a dcterms:Location.

name: degreeOfEstablishment
definition: The degree to which a dwc:Organism survives, reproduces, and expands its range at the given place and time.

name: disposition
definition: A current state of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to where it can be found.

name: DwCType
definition: The set of classes specified by the Darwin Core Type Vocabulary, used to categorize the nature or genre of the resource.

name: dynamicProperties
definition: A list of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the record. Meant to provide a mechanism for structured content.

name: earliestAgeOrLowestStage
definition: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic age or lowest chronostratigraphic stage attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: EarliestDateCollected
definition: The earliest date-time in a period during which a event occurred. If the event is recorded as occurring at a single date-time, populate both EarliestDateCollected and LatestDateCollected with the same value. Recommended best practice is to use an encoding scheme, such as ISO 8601:2004(E).

name: earliestEonOrLowestEonothem
definition: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic eon or lowest chronostratigraphic eonothem or the informal name attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: earliestEpochOrLowestSeries
definition: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic epoch or lowest chronostratigraphic series attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: earliestEraOrLowestErathem
definition: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic era or lowest chronostratigraphic erathem attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: earliestPeriodOrLowestSystem
definition: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic period or lowest chronostratigraphic system attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: endDayOfYear
definition: The latest integer day of the year on which a dwc:Event occurred.

name: EndTimeOfDay
definition: The time of day when the event ended, expressed as decimal hours from midnight, local time.

name: establishmentMeans
definition: Statement about whether a dwc:Organism has been introduced to a given place and time through the direct or indirect activity of modern humans.

name: Event
definition: An action, process, or set of circumstances occurring at a dcterms:Location during a period of time.

name: EventAttribute
definition: Container class for information about attributes related to a given sampling event.

name: EventAttributeAccuracy
definition: The description of the error associated with the EventAttributeValue.

name: EventAttributeDeterminedBy
definition: The agent responsible for having determined the value of the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event.

name: EventAttributeDeterminedDate
definition: The date on which the the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event was made.

name: EventAttributeID
definition: An identifier for the event attribute. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: EventAttributeRemarks
definition: Comments or notes accompanying the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event.

name: eventAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements or characteristics of the Event.

name: EventAttributeType
definition: The nature of the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: EventAttributeUnit
definition: The units for the value of the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event. Recommended best practice is to use International System of Units (SI) units.

name: EventAttributeValue
definition: The value of the measurement or characteristic of the sampling event.

name: eventDate
definition: A date-time or time interval during which a dwc:Event occurred.

name: eventID
definition: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: EventMeasurement
definition: The category of information pertaining to measurements associated with an event.

name: eventMeasurementAccuracy
definition: The description of the error associated with the EventAttributeValue.

name: eventMeasurementDeterminedBy
definition: The agent responsible for having determined the value of the measurement or characteristic of the event.

name: eventMeasurementDeterminedDate
definition: The date on which the the measurement or characteristic of the event was made. Recommended best practice is to use an encoding scheme, such as ISO 8601:2004(E).

name: eventMeasurementID
definition: An identifier for the event attribute. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: eventMeasurementRemarks
definition: Comments or notes accompanying the measurement or characteristic of the event.

name: eventMeasurementType
definition: The nature of the measurement or characteristic of the event. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: eventMeasurementUnit
definition: The units for the value of the measurement or characteristic of the event. Recommended best practice is to use International System of Units (SI) units.

name: eventMeasurementValue
definition: The value of the measurement or characteristic of the event.

name: eventRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the dwc:Event.

name: eventTime
definition: The time or interval during which a dwc:Event occurred.

name: eventType
definition: A narrow category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Event.

name: family
definition: The full scientific name of the family in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: fieldNotes
definition: One of a) an indicator of the existence of, b) a reference to (publication, URI), or c) the text of notes taken in the field about the dwc:Event.

name: fieldNumber
definition: An identifier given to a dwc:Event in the field.

name: footprintSpatialFit
definition: A ratio of the area of a footprint (dwc:footprintWKT) to the area of a true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of a dcterms:Location.

name: footprintSRS
definition: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geometry given in dwc:footprintWKT is based.

name: footprintWKT
definition: A Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the shape (footprint, geometry) that defines a dcterms:Location.

name: formation
definition: The full name of the lithostratigraphic formation from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: FossilSpecimen
definition: A preserved specimen that is a fossil.

name: Generalizations
definition: Actions taken to make the data as shared less specific or complete than in its original form. Suggests that alternative data of highly quality may be available on request.

name: genericName
definition: The genus part of the dwc:scientificName without authorship.

name: genus
definition: The full scientific name of the genus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: geodeticDatum
definition: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geographic coordinates given in dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude are based.

name: GeologicalContext
definition: A set of geological designations, such as stratigraphy, that qualify a dcterms:Location or source of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: geologicalContextID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:GeologicalContext.

name: georeferencedBy
definition: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for providing a georeference.

name: georeferencedDate
definition: The date on which the dcterms:Location was georeferenced.

name: georeferenceProtocol
definition: A description or reference to a dwc:Protocol used to determine a spatial footprint, coordinates, and uncertainties.

name: georeferenceRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the spatial description determination, explaining assumptions made in addition or opposition to the those formalized in the method referred to in dwc:georeferenceProtocol.

name: georeferenceSources
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of maps, gazetteers, or other resources used to georeference a dcterms:Location, described specifically enough to allow anyone in the future to use the same resources.

name: georeferenceVerificationStatus
definition: A categorical description of the extent to which the georeference has been verified to represent the best possible spatial description for the dcterms:Location of the dwc:Occurrence.

name: group
definition: The full name of the lithostratigraphic group from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: habitat
definition: A category or description of the habitat in which the dwc:Event occurred.

name: higherClassification
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of taxa names terminating at the rank immediately superior to the referenced dwc:Taxon.

name: higherGeography
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of geographic names less specific than the information captured in the dwc:locality term.

name: higherGeographyID
definition: An identifier for the geographic region within which the dcterms:Location occurred.

name: HigherTaxon
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of the names for the taxonomic ranks less specific than the ScientificName.

name: higherTaxonconceptID
definition: A unique identifier for the taxon concept less specific than that given in the taxonConceptID.

name: HigherTaxonID
definition: A global unique identifier for the parent to the taxon.

name: higherTaxonName
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of the names for the taxonomic ranks less specific than that given in the scientificName.

name: higherTaxonNameID
definition: A unique identifier for the name of the next higher rank than the scientificName in a taxonomic classification. See higherTaxonName.

name: highestBiostratigraphicZone
definition: The full name of the highest possible geological biostratigraphic zone of the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: HumanObservation
definition: An output of a human observation process.

name: Identification
definition: A classification of a resource according to a classification scheme.

name: identificationAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the Identification.

name: identificationID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Identification.

name: identificationQualifier
definition: A brief phrase or a standard term ("cf.", "aff.") to express the determiner's doubts about the dwc:Identification.

name: identificationReferences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources used in a dwc:Identification.

name: identificationRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the dwc:Identification.

name: identificationVerificationStatus
definition: A categorical indicator of the extent to which a dwc:Identification has been verified to be correct.

name: identifiedBy
definition: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.

name: identifiedByID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.

name: individualCount
definition: The number of individuals present at the time of the dwc:Occurrence.

name: individualID
definition: An identifier for an individual or named group of individual organisms represented in the Occurrence. Meant to accommodate resampling of the same individual or group for monitoring purposes. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to a data set.

name: informationWithheld
definition: Additional information that exists about a resource, but that is not shared publicly. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.

name: infragenericEpithet
definition: The infrageneric part of a binomial name at ranks above species but below genus.

name: infraspecificEpithet
definition: The name of the lowest or terminal infraspecific of the dwc:scientificName.

name: institutionCode
definition: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having custody of a resource.

name: institutionID
definition: An identifier for an organization.

name: island
definition: The name of the island on or near which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: islandGroup
definition: The name of the island group in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: kingdom
definition: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: latestAgeOrHighestStage
definition: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic age or highest chronostratigraphic stage attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: LatestDateCollected
definition: The latest date-time in a period during which a event occurred. If the event is recorded as occurring at a single date-time, populate both EarliestDateCollected and LatestDateCollected with the same value. Recommended best practice is to use an encoding scheme, such as ISO 8601:2004(E).

name: latestEonOrHighestEonothem
definition: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic eon or highest chronostratigraphic eonothem or the informal name attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: latestEpochOrHighestSeries
definition: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic epoch or highest chronostratigraphic series attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: latestEraOrHighestErathem
definition: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic era or highest chronostratigraphic erathem attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: latestPeriodOrHighestSystem
definition: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic period or highest chronostratigraphic system attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: lifeStage
definition: An age class or life stage of a dwc:Organism.

name: lithostratigraphicTerms
definition: The combination of all lithostratigraphic names for the rock from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: LivingSpecimen
definition: A specimen that is alive.

name: locality
definition: The specific description of the place.

name: locationAccordingTo
definition: Information about the source of this dcterms:Location information. Could be a publication (gazetteer), institution, or team of individuals.

name: locationAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the location.

name: locationID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:Location.

name: locationRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the dcterms:Location.

name: lowestBiostratigraphicZone
definition: The full name of the lowest possible geological biostratigraphic zone of the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: MachineObservation
definition: An output of a machine observation process.

name: MaterialCitation
definition: A reference to or citation of one, a part of, or multiple specimens in scholarly publications.

name: MaterialEntity
definition: An entity that can be identified, exists for some period of time, and consists in whole or in part of physical matter while it exists.

name: materialEntityID
definition: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: materialEntityRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: MaterialSample
definition: A material entity that represents an entity of interest in whole or in part.

name: materialSampleID
definition: An identifier for the dwc:MaterialSample (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:MaterialSample). In the absence of a persistent global unique identifier, construct one from a combination of identifiers in the record that will most closely make the dwc:materialSampleID globally unique.

name: maximumDepthInMeters
definition: The greatest depth within a range of depths, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.

name: maximumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
definition: The greater distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

name: maximumElevationInMeters
definition: The greatest elevation within a range of elevations, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.

name: measurementAccuracy
definition: The description of the potential error associated with the dwc:measurementValue.

name: measurementDeterminedBy
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the value of the dwc:MeasurementOrFact.

name: measurementDeterminedDate
definition: The date on which the dwc:MeasurementOrFact was made.

name: measurementID
definition: An identifier for the dwc:MeasurementOrFact (information pertaining to measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: measurementMethod
definition: A description of or reference to (publication, URI) the method or protocol used to determine the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

name: MeasurementOrFact
definition: A measurement of or fact about an rdfs:Resource (http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Resource).

name: measurementRemarks
definition: Comments or notes accompanying the dwc:MeasurementOrFact.

name: measurementType
definition: The nature of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

name: measurementUnit
definition: The units associated with the dwc:measurementValue.

name: measurementValue
definition: The value of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

name: member
definition: The full name of the lithostratigraphic member from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: minimumDepthInMeters
definition: The least depth within a range of depths, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.

name: minimumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
definition: The lesser distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

name: minimumElevationInMeters
definition: The least elevation within a range of elevations, measured relative to the vertical reference surface indicated by the value of dwc:verticalDatum.

name: month
definition: The integer month in which the dwc:Event occurred.

name: municipality
definition: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than county (city, municipality, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs. Do not use this term for a nearby named place that does not contain the actual dcterms:Location.

name: nameAccordingTo
definition: The reference to the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied - traditionally signified by the Latin "sensu" or "sec." (from secundum, meaning "according to"). For taxa that result from identifications, a reference to the keys, monographs, experts and other sources should be given.

name: nameAccordingToID
definition: An identifier for the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied. See dwc:nameAccordingTo.

name: namePublicationID
definition: A resolvable globally unique identifier for the original publication of the scientificName.

name: namePublishedIn
definition: A reference for the publication in which the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

name: namePublishedInID
definition: An identifier for the publication in which the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

name: namePublishedInYear
definition: The four-digit year in which the dwc:scientificName was published.

name: nomenclaturalCode
definition: The nomenclatural code (or codes in the case of an ambiregnal name) under which the dwc:scientificName is constructed.

name: nomenclaturalStatus
definition: The status related to the original publication of the name and its conformance to the relevant rules of nomenclature. It is based essentially on an algorithm according to the business rules of the code. It requires no taxonomic opinion.

name: Occurrence
definition: A dwc:Event that establishes the state of a dwc:Organism at a particular place and time.

name: occurrenceAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the Occurrence.

name: occurrenceDetails
definition: A reference (publication, URI) to the most detailed information available about the Occurrence.

name: occurrenceID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Occurrence (as opposed to a particular digital record of a dwc:Occurrence).

name: OccurrenceMeasurement
definition: The category of information pertaining to measurements accociated with an occurrence.

name: occurrenceMeasurementAccuracy
definition: The description of the error associated with the occurrenceAttributeValue.

name: occurrenceMeasurementDeterminedBy
definition: The agent responsible for having determined the value of the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence.

name: occurrenceMeasurementDeterminedDate
definition: The date on which the the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence was made. Recommended best practice is to use an encoding scheme, such as ISO 8601:2004(E).

name: occurrenceMeasurementID
definition: An identifier for the occurrence attribute. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: occurrenceMeasurementRemarks
definition: Comments or notes accompanying the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence.

name: occurrenceMeasurementType
definition: The nature of the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: occurrenceMeasurementUnit
definition: The units for the value of the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence. Recommended best practice is to use International System of Units (SI) units.

name: occurrenceMeasurementValue
definition: The value of the measurement or characteristic of the occurrence.

name: occurrenceRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the dwc:Occurrence.

name: occurrenceStatus
definition: A statement about the detection or non-detection of a dwc:Organism during a dwc:Event.

name: order
definition: The full scientific name of the order in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: Organism
definition: A particular organism or defined group of organisms considered to be taxonomically homogeneous.

name: organismID
definition: An identifier for the dwc:Organism instance (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:Organism). May be a globally unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: organismName
definition: A textual name or label assigned to a dwc:Organism instance.

name: organismQuantity
definition: A number or enumeration value for the quantity of dwc:Organisms.

name: organismQuantityType
definition: The type of quantification system used for the quantity of dwc:Organisms.

name: organismRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the dwc:Organism instance.

name: organismScope
definition: A description of the kind of dwc:Organism instance. Can be used to indicate whether the dwc:Organism instance represents a discrete organism or if it represents a particular type of aggregation.

name: originalNameUsage
definition: The taxon name, with authorship and date information if known, as it originally appeared when first established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode. The basionym (botany) or basonym (bacteriology) of the dwc:scientificName or the senior/earlier homonym for replaced names.

name: originalNameUsageID
definition: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) in which the terminal element of the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

name: otherCatalogNumbers
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous or alternate fully qualified catalog numbers or other human-used identifiers for the same dwc:MaterialEntity, whether in the current or any other data set or collection.

name: ownerInstitutionCode
definition: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having ownership of a resource.

name: parentEventID
definition: An identifier for a broader dwc:Event that contains this and potentially other dwc:Events.

name: parentMeasurementID
definition: An identifier for a broader dwc:MeasurementOrFact that groups this and potentially other dwc:MeasurementOrFacts.

name: parentNameUsage
definition: The full name, with authorship and date information if known, of the direct, most proximate higher-rank parent dwc:Taxon (in a classification) of the most specific element of the dwc:scientificName.

name: parentNameUsageID
definition: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the direct, most proximate higher-rank parent taxon (in a classification) of the most specific element of the dwc:scientificName.

name: pathway
definition: The process by which a dwc:Organism came to be in a given place at a given time.

name: phylum
definition: The full scientific name of the phylum or division in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: pointRadiusSpatialFit
definition: A ratio of the area of a point-radius (dwc:decimalLatitude, dwc:decimalLongitude, dwc:coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) to the area of a true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of a dcterms:Location.

name: preparations
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of preparations and preservation methods for a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: PreservedSpecimen
definition: A specimen that has been preserved.

name: PreviousIdentifications
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous ScientificNames to which the sample was identified.

name: previousIdentifications
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous assignments of names to the dwc:Organism.

name: recordedBy
definition: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for recording a dwc:Event.

name: recordedByID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for recording a dwc:Event.

name: recordNumber
definition: An identifier given to the dwc:Occurrence at the time it was recorded. Often serves as a link between field notes and a dwc:MaterialEntity record, such as a specimen collector's number.

name: RelatedBasisOfRecord
definition: The nature of the related resource. Recommended best practice is to use the same controlled vocabulary as for basisOfRecord.

name: relatedResourceID
definition: An identifier for the related resource (the object) of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.

name: relatedResourceType
definition: The type of the related resource. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: relationshipAccordingTo
definition: The source (person, organization, publication, reference) establishing the relationship between the two resources.

name: relationshipEstablishedDate
definition: A date-time or time interval during which a dwc:ResourceRelationship was established.

name: relationshipOfResource
definition: The relationship of the subject (identified by dwc:resourceID) to the object (identified by dwc:relatedResourceID).

name: relationshipOfResourceID
definition: An identifier for the relationship type (predicate) that connects the subject identified by dwc:resourceID to its object identified by dwc:relatedResourceID.

name: relationshipRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dwc:ResourceRelationship.

name: reproductiveCondition
definition: A reproductive condition of a dwc:Organism.

name: resourceID
definition: An identifier for the subject of a dwc:ResourceRelationship.

name: ResourceRelationship
definition: A relationship of one rdfs:Resource (http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Resource) to another.

name: resourceRelationshipID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:ResourceRelationship.

name: Sample
definition: Container class for information about the results of a sampling event (specimen, observation, etc.)

name: SampleAttribute
definition: Container class for information about attributes related to a given sample.

name: SampleAttributeAccuracy
definition: The description of the error associated with the SampleAttributeValue.

name: SampleAttributeDeterminedBy
definition: The agent responsible for having determined the value of the measurement or characteristic of the sample.

name: SampleAttributeDeterminedDate
definition: The date on which the the measurement or characteristic of the sample was made.

name: SampleAttributeRemarks
definition: Comments or notes accompanying the measurement or characteristic of the sample.

name: SampleAttributeUnit
definition: The units for the value of the measurement or characteristic of the sample. Recommended best practice is to use International System of Units (SI) units.

name: SampleAttributeValue
definition: The value of the measurement or characteristic of the sample.

name: SampleRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the sample or record.

name: sampleSizeUnit
definition: The unit of measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

name: sampleSizeValue
definition: A numeric value for a measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

name: SamplingAttributeID
definition: An identifier for the sampling attribute. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: SamplingAttributeType
definition: The nature of the measurement or characteristic of the sample. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: samplingEffort
definition: The amount of effort expended during an eco:Survey.

name: SamplingEvent
definition: Container class for information about the conditions and methods of acquisition of samples.

name: SamplingEventAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements or characteristics of the sampling event.

name: SamplingEventID
definition: An identifier for the sampling event. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: SamplingEventRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the sampling event.

name: SamplingLocation
definition: Container class for information about the location where a sampling event occurred.

name: SamplingLocationID
definition: An identifier for the sampling location. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: SamplingLocationRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the sampling location.

name: samplingProtocol
definition: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during an eco:Survey.

name: scientificName
definition: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of a dwc:Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined.

name: scientificNameAuthorship
definition: The authorship information for the dwc:scientificName formatted according to the conventions of the applicable dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

name: scientificNameID
definition: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.

name: scientificNameRank
definition: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the scientificName. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

name: sex
definition: A sex of a dwc:Organism.

name: specificEpithet
definition: The name of the first or species epithet of the dwc:scientificName.

name: startDayOfYear
definition: The earliest integer day of the year on which a dwc:Event occurred.

name: StartTimeOfDay
definition: The time of day when the event began, expressed as decimal hours from midnight, local time.

name: stateProvince
definition: The name of the next smaller administrative region than country (state, province, canton, department, region, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: subfamily
definition: The full scientific name of the subfamily in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: subgenus
definition: The full scientific name of the subgenus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: subtribe
definition: The full scientific name of the subtribe in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: superfamily
definition: The full scientific name of the superfamily in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: Taxon
definition: A group of organisms (sensu http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100026) considered by taxonomists to form a homogeneous unit.

name: taxonAccordingTo
definition: Information about the authorship of this taxon concept which uses the scientificName in their sense (secundum, sensu). Could be a publication (identification key), institution or team of individuals.

name: taxonAttributes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the taxon.

name: taxonConceptID
definition: An identifier for the taxonomic concept to which the record refers - not for the nomenclatural details of a dwc:Taxon.

name: TaxonID
definition: A global unique identifier for the taxon (name in a classification).

name: taxonID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Taxon.

name: taxonNameID
definition: A unique identifier for the scientificName.

name: taxonomicStatus
definition: The status of the use of the dwc:scientificName as a label for a taxon. Requires taxonomic opinion to define the scope of a dwc:Taxon. Rules of priority then are used to define the taxonomic status of the nomenclature contained in that scope, combined with the experts opinion. It must be linked to a specific taxonomic reference that defines the concept.

name: taxonRank
definition: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName.

name: taxonRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the taxon or name.

name: tribe
definition: The full scientific name of the tribe in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

name: typeStatus
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of nomenclatural types (type status, typified scientific name, publication) applied to the subject.

name: verbatimCoordinates
definition: Verbatim original spatial coordinates of a dcterms:Location.

name: verbatimCoordinateSystem
definition: A coordinate format for dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude or dwc:verbatimCoordinates.

name: verbatimDepth
definition: The original description of the depth below the local surface.

name: verbatimElevation
definition: An original description of the elevation of a dcterms:Location.

name: verbatimEventDate
definition: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for a dwc:Event.

name: verbatimIdentification
definition: A string representing the classification as it appeared in the original record.

name: verbatimLabel
definition: A verbatim original representation of the written information affixed or related to a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: verbatimLatitude
definition: A verbatim original latitude of a dcterms:Location.

name: verbatimLocality
definition: An original textual description of a dcterms:Location.

name: verbatimLongitude
definition: A verbatim original longitude of a dcterms:Location.

name: verbatimScientificNameRank
definition: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the scientificName as it appears in the original record.

name: verbatimSRS
definition: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which coordinates given in dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude, or dwc:verbatimCoordinates are based.

name: verbatimTaxonRank
definition: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName as it appears in the original record.

name: vernacularName
definition: A common or vernacular name.

name: verticalDatum
definition: The vertical datum used as the reference upon which the values in the elevation terms are based.

name: vitality
definition: An indication of whether a dwc:Organism was alive or dead at the time of collection or observation.

name: waterBody
definition: The name of the water body in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

name: year
definition: The four-digit year in which the dwc:Event occurred, according to the Common Era Calendar.

name: feedbackURL
definition: A uniform resource locator (URL) that points to a webpage on which a form may be submitted to gather feedback about the record.

name: typifiedName
definition: A scientific name for which a specimen or other name is the type.

name: fundingAttributionID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent that financially supported a project.

name: projectID
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers for projects that contributed to a dwc:Event.

name: projectTitle
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of titles or names for projects that contributed to a dwc:Event.

name: digitalSpecimenID
definition: An identifier for a Digital Specimen resource.

name: causeOfDeath
definition: An indication of the known or suspected cause of death of a dwc:Organism.

name: verbatimMeasurementType
definition: A string representing the type of measurement or fact as it appeared in the original record.

name: materialEntityType
definition: A more generic classification of a dwc:MaterialEntity than dwc:preparations but less broad than dwc:materialEntityCategory.

name: discipline
definition: The primary branch or branches of knowledge represented by a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: agentRoleOrder
definition: A numerical position of an AgentRole in a set of AgentRoles.

name: agentID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent.

name: agentRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dcterms:Agent.

name: agentType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dcterms:Agent.

name: Assertion
definition: A statement about an rdfs:Resource (http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Resource).

name: assertionID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Assertion.

name: verbatimAssertionType
definition: A string representing the type of dwc:Assertion as it appeared in an original record.

name: assertionType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Assertion.

name: assertionMadeDate
definition: A date on which a dwc:Assertion was created.

name: assertionEffectiveDate
definition: A date-time or time interval during which an asserted state or measurement was deemed to be in effect.

name: assertionValue
definition: An asserted value.

name: assertionUnit
definition: A unit associated with the value in dwc:assertionValue.

name: assertionError
definition: A description of the potential error associated with a dwc:assertionValue.

name: assertionBy
definition: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Assertion.

name: assertionProtocols
definition: Names of, references to, or descriptions of dwc:Protocols used in making a dwc:Assertion.

name: assertionReferences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources associated with a dwc:Assertion.

name: assertionRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dwc:Assertion.

name: referenceID
definition: An identifier for a dcterms:BibliographicResource.

name: referenceRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dcterms:BibliographicResource.

name: referenceType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dcterms:BibliographicResource.

name: eventCategory
definition: A broad category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Event.

name: sampledSubstrateLayer
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of substrate layers sampled during a dwc:Event.

name: sampledSubstrateCategory
definition: A category or type of substrate sampled during a dwc:Event.

name: isAcceptedIdentification
definition: An indicator that a dwc:Identification of a dwc:Organism is a currently an accepted or preferred one.

name: identificationType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Identification.

name: taxonFormula
definition: A string representing the pattern to use to construct a dwc:Identification from dwc:Taxon names and identification qualifiers.

name: preferredSpatialRepresentation
definition: An indication of which spatial representation best represents the dcterms:Location.

name: siteNumber
definition: An identifier for a named site.

name: materialEntityCategory
definition: A high-level, mutually exclusive classification describing the fundamental substance and origin of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: objectQuantity
definition: A number or enumeration value for the quantity of differentiable dwc:MaterialEntities comprising this dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: objectQuantityType
definition: The type of quantification system used for the quantity of dwc:MaterialEntities.

name: typeOfType
definition: A category of nomenclatural type of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: MolecularProtocol
definition: A protocol used to perform a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis and potentially derive a dwc:NucleotideSequence from a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: assayType
definition: A type of method used in a study to detect taxon/taxa of interest in a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: molecularProtocolID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:MolecularProtocol.

name: NucleotideAnalysis
definition: A link between a dwc:NucleotideSequence or a dwc:Identification and a dwc:Event and a dwc:MaterialEntity from which it was derived, using a specified dwc:Protocol.

name: readCount
definition: The number of reads obtained for a processed dwc:NucleotideSequence during a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.

name: processedTotalReadCount
definition: The total number of reads obtained for a processed dwc:NucleotideSequence during a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.

name: NucleotideSequence
definition: A digital representation of a nucleotide sequence.

name: sequence
definition: A string representing nucleotide base pairs.

name: nucleotideSequenceRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dwc:NucleotideSequence.

name: OrganismInteraction
definition: An interaction between two dwc:Organisms during a dwc:Event.

name: organismInteractionDescription
definition: A verbatim description of a dwc:OrganismInteraction.

name: organismInteractionID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:OrganismInteraction.

name: organismInteractionType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:OrganismInteraction.

name: Protocol
definition: A method used during an action.

name: protocolID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Protocol.

name: protocolDescription
definition: A detailed description of a dwc:Protocol.

name: protocolRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about a dwc:Protocol.

name: protocolType
definition: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:Protocol.

name: protocolReferences
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources used in a dwc:Protocol.

name: Provenance
definition: Information about an entity’s origins.

name: UsagePolicy
definition: Information about rights, usage, and attribution statements applicable to an entity.

name: bibliographicIdentifier
definition: A number or symbol to uniquely identify a dcterms:BibliographicResource.

name: bibliographicIdentifierType
definition: A code that best matches the nature of an identifier for a dcterms:BibliographicResource.

name: namedPlace
definition: The full, unabbreviated name of a geographic location not otherwise categorized by a dcterms:Location property that is naturally occurring or anthropogenic in origin within a historical, administrative, or cultural context in which a dcterms:Location occurs.

name: geologicEvent
definition: A name of an identifiable event during which one or more geologic processes acted to create or modify one or more dwc:GeologicalMaterials.

name: geologicProvince
definition: An extensive named region with similar geologic history, structural, petrographic, or physiographic features throughout in which the GeologicalContext was located.

name: lithodemicUnit
definition: A geologic unit that lacks stratification, is primarily comprised of intrusive, deformed, and/or metamorphosed rock, and is characterized by irregularly mixed lithology or highly complicated structural relations.

name: tectonicUnits
definition: The combination of all tectonic unit names for the rock from which a dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

name: chemistryRemarks
definition: General remarks about the chemical and isotopic composition of a dwc:GeologicalMaterial.

name: classificationCodes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of codes that each identifies a name from a classification system applied to a dwc:GeologicalMaterial.

name: geologicalMaterialNames
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of mineral or lithotaxon names for a dwc:GeologicalMaterial.

name: geologicalMaterialNameTypes
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of the types of names provided in dwc:geologicalMaterialNames.

name: geologicMaterialNameID
definition: An identifier for a mineral or lithotaxon name for a dwc:GeologicalMaterial. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

name: measuredChemistry
definition: A concise expression of the chemical composition of a mineral that shows the number of atoms of each element in a molecule, their spatial arrangement, and their linkage to each other.

name: measuredChemistrySource
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of resources associated with the reported measured chemistry described specifically enough to allow anyone in the future to use the same resources.

name: mineralogicalAnalysisProtocol
definition: A technique used to determine the chemical composition or crystallography of a mineral.

name: mineralSequence
definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of minerals in a dwc:GeologicalMaterial, ordered in a manner that illustrates the relative timing of mineral formation.

name: classificationSystem
definition: A reference to the classification system in which an authoritative name or formal classification belongs.

name: taxonSortOrder
definition: A numerical position of a dwc:Taxon in a dwc:taxonFormula.

name: damageRemarks
definition: A general description of any physical changes to a dwc:MaterialEntity that have negatively affected its value.

name: handlingRequirements
definition: A description of the procedures required to preserve and protect a dwc:MaterialEntity during handling.

name: hazardRemarks
definition: Comments or notes about the type of hazards associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: hazardType
definition: A term that belongs to a hazard classification scheme based on a set of unique characteristics and negative health outcomes.

name: isPartOfMaterialEntityID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity of which this dwc:MaterialEntity is a part.

name: materialDescription
definition: Remarks on the physical characteristics of a dwc:MaterialEntity, particularly those that distinguish it from otherwise similar dwc:MaterialEntities.

name: materialProportion
definition: The qualitative or quantitative abundance of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.

name: materialRole
definition: A category that best matches the nature of the relationship between a dwc:MaterialEntity and another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.

name: measuredMassInGrams
definition: Mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, measured in grams.

name: sampledFeatureType
definition: The type of naturally occurring or anthropogenic physical feature from which a dwc:MaterialEntity was sampled.

name: treatments
definition: Description of any processes or curatorial actions taken specifically to mitigate damage to a dwc:MaterialEntity.

name: verbatimMass
definition: The verbatim original representation of the mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, including original units of measurement.

name: rawTotalReadCount
definition: A total number of raw, unprocessed reads from a dwc:NucleotideAnalysis.

name: substrate
definition: A type of biotic or abiotic material to which a dwc:Organism was attached during a dwc:Occurrence.

name: provenanceID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:Provenance.

name: usagePolicyID
definition: An identifier for a dwc:UsagePolicy.

name: GeologicalMaterial
definition: A dwc:MaterialEntity that is geological in nature.

name: organismPart
definition: An anatomical part of a dwc:Organism.

name: language
definition: A language of the resource.

name: type
definition: The nature or genre of the resource.

name: accessRights
definition: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.

name: bibliographicCitation
definition: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

name: language
definition: A language of the resource.

name: license
definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

name: Location
definition: A spatial region or named place.

name: modified
definition: Date on which the resource was changed.

name: references
definition: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

name: rightsHolder
definition: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

name: type
definition: The nature or genre of the resource.

name: rights
definition: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

name: BibliographicResource
definition: A book, article, or other documentary resource.

name: Agent
definition: A resource that acts or has the power to act.
